title: Silent Hill 3
synopsis: Team Silent’s third Silent Hill — retained as the North American PlayStation 2 retail disc that carried Heather’s chapter onto this shelf.

catalog.mediumForm: Pressed optical disc · PlayStation 2 retail edition

custody.physical: Complete in box: case, pressed disc, manual, and original cover insert
custody.condition: Complete in box. Light shelf wear consistent with age. Preserved as a playable reference copy.

curatorNotes:
Silent Hill 3 returns the series to a direct reckoning with the first game’s cult while keeping Team Silent’s PS2 craft — mall corridors, amusement-park dread, and a protagonist whose ordinary life is the wrong kind of inheritance. Konami’s North American disc (SLUS-20622) arrived in August 2003.

The shelf keeps the original retail edition rather than a later budget repress. What matters is the optical object that sat beside Silent Hill 2 in the same generation’s keep-case language.

Together with the PlayStation original and the other numbered Team Silent releases filed here, this copy makes the series readable as a sequence of discs rather than a reputation.
collectionNotes:
Acquired in August 2026 while expanding the PlayStation 2 physical shelf.

The retained copy is the North American PlayStation 2 edition published by Konami (SLUS-20622). It remains complete in box with manual and cover insert, and is kept as the reference copy for this filing.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Sony PlayStation 2; compatible North American PlayStation hardware
preservation.compatibility: Pressed for North American PlayStation 2 consoles. The retained disc remains the primary access copy.
preservation.concerns: Optical-disc aging and surface damage remain the principal risks. The disc is stored upright in its original case under stable, dry conditions; printed materials remain housed with the copy.
preservation.knownRevisions: North American PlayStation 2 release published by Konami on August 8, 2003 (SLUS-20622). Japanese and European territories followed the same year. Some North American copies included an official soundtrack disc; packaging variants are noted where present. Later budget reissues used revised packaging; this filing records the original retail edition.
preservation.availability: The original physical edition is out of print and circulates through the secondary market. No current digital edition replaces this North American reference copy.
